request.spec:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each sheet now has its own "today", shown and changeable on the screen, and the acceptance test passes under `bin/e2e`.

- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V2__sheet_today.sql`, adds a `today` column to the sheet table. A new sheet starts with today set to the real date.
- **Server:** the sheet's today is stored on `Sheet`, and `SheetService` has `today(id)` to read it and `setToday(id, date)` to change it. Creating a sheet is now the only place the real clock is read. `SheetController` includes `today` in what it returns for a sheet, and a new `PUT /api/sheets/{id}/today` changes it. A malformed or missing date is refused.
- **Front end:** a new component, `features/session/sheet-today.ts`, appears on the home screen once a sheet is loaded. It shows the date (`sheet-today`), has a date field (`sheet-today-input`) and a save button (`sheet-today-save`). If the date is badly formed or the server rejects it, it shows the error `sheet-error`, which clears when the field is edited.

The app doesn't yet have any other date-based decisions or default dates. Future features should take their dates from `SheetService.today(id)` on the server or `session.sheet().today` in the front end, never the real clock.

Changing today doesn't write an audit record, because the test doesn't ask for one.
